forcedChoices.reason: Spanish forces a gender; the generic masculine keeps men and women open.
Here 'fellowship' means membership in a group; the earlier form 'compañerismo' means companionship, and 'comunión' has a sacramental sense. Same in 135:6.4.
'espiritistas' means people who practice spiritism (seances); the papers mean those who held a spiritual view of the kingdom.
'era' also means 'age', a key word of this paper; 'trilladero' avoids that second sense.
The English keeps the village name Adam; 'Adán' would point the reader to the Material Son.
The packet rule: use 'usted' to a ruler; Herod speaks to her with 'tú'.
'daughters' forces the feminine, as in the English.
